name: forge
description: Principle-first agent workflows that preserve intent, approved contracts, and verified outcomes, with optional planning, TDD, and source-backed Visual Docs.

interface.shortDescription: Clear outcomes, durable contracts, proportionate execution.
interface.longDescription: Forge helps agents finish authorized work, preserve approved project contracts, and verify observable results. It uses existing tests and adds regression protection where needed; TDD is available when useful or requested. Questions, plans, delegation, and records follow actual uncertainty and recovery needs. Structured Canonical Specs retain their validated interfaces. Forge visualizations preserve source meaning with free format choice; managed rendering is optional for reproducible documents and freshness checks. Forge also includes cross-agent extension authoring, evidence-based debugging, product-specific UI design, and house writing guidance.
